title: Restaurants Don't Care About Your Fitness Goals
hook: I don't have the money for a gym membership.
body:
But you look at their credit card statement, and they're eating out at restaurants two or three times per week.

When you're going to restaurants, they don't care about your long-term fitness goals. They only care about making you happy in the moment. They just want you to have a delicious meal.
close: If you sacrifice restaurants for just a few weeks, that will free up hundreds of dollars that you could reinvest in your health.
